topic: What if the internet just disappeared forever without warning?
title: WHAT IF THE INTERNET
DISAPPEARED FOREVER?

youtube.title: What If Internet Just Disappeared FOREVER Without Warning?!
youtube.intro: At 7:42 on a Tuesday morning, every connection on Earth stops, and it never comes back. The first day feels like a holiday. Then the card machines, the supermarkets, the planes and the pharmacies stop too. And your phone holds the one thing everyone suddenly wants.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Would you have given the man in the suit the phone? 👇

And who wrote "Shutdown complete" one minute before it happened? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The real parts check out: the 6-hour Facebook/WhatsApp outage (2021), 8.5 million computers down in the CrowdStrike crash (2024), ~3 days of food in grocery supply chains, and all of Wikipedia fitting on a phone (~100 GB). Sources are in the description.

🔔 Subscribe so you don't miss Part 2: what happens after "Shutdown complete"?
